    25	/-- `FiniteInAffine` descends along open immersions. -/
    26	theorem finiteInAffine_of_isOpenImmersion {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    27	    [IsOpenImmersion f] (hY : FiniteInAffine Y) : FiniteInAffine X := by
    28	  classical
    29	  intro s hs
    30	  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := hY (f.base '' s) (hs.image f.base)
    31	  letI : Fintype s := hs.fintype
    32	  obtain ⟨r, hr, hrle⟩ :=
    33	    AlgebraicJacobian.GaloisDescent.exists_basicOpen_le_of_finite U.2
    34	      (fun x : s => f.base x)
    35	      (fun x => hU ⟨x, x.2, rfl⟩)
    36	      (fun x => Scheme.Hom.mem_opensRange.mpr ⟨(x : X), rfl⟩)
    37	  refine ⟨⟨f ⁻¹ᵁ Y.basicOpen r,
    38	    (U.2.basicOpen r).preimage_of_isOpenImmersion f hrle⟩, ?_⟩
    39	  intro x hx
    40	  change f.base x ∈ Y.basicOpen r
    41	  exact hr ⟨x, hx⟩

    43	/-- `FiniteInAffine` descends along arbitrary immersions. -/
    44	theorem finiteInAffine_of_isImmersion {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    45	    [IsImmersion f] (hY : FiniteInAffine Y) : FiniteInAffine X := by
    46	  obtain ⟨Z, g₁, g₂, hg₁, hg₂, -⟩ :=
    47	    (AlgebraicGeometry.IsImmersion.isImmersion_iff_exists (f := f)).mp
    48	      (inferInstance : IsImmersion f)
    49	  haveI := hg₁
    50	  haveI := hg₂
    51	  exact finiteInAffine_of_isAffineHom g₁
    52	    (finiteInAffine_of_isOpenImmersion g₂ hY)

    54	/-- Relative projective space over an affine base satisfies `FiniteInAffine`. -/
    55	theorem finiteInAffine_projectiveSpace (n : Type u) (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine S] :
    56	    FiniteInAffine (ProjectiveSpace n S) := by
    57	  haveI : IsAffineHom (ProjectiveSpace.toProjInt n S) := by
    58	    rw [ProjectiveSpace.toProjInt_eq_snd]
    59	    exact MorphismProperty.pullback_snd _ _ inferInstance
    60	  exact finiteInAffine_of_isAffineHom (ProjectiveSpace.toProjInt n S)
    61	    (finiteInAffine_proj (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule n (ULift.{u} ℤ)))

    63	/-- A scheme projective over an affine base satisfies `FiniteInAffine`. -/
    64	theorem finiteInAffine_of_isProjective {X S : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine S] {π : X ⟶ S}
    65	    (h : π.IsProjective) : FiniteInAffine X := by
    66	  obtain ⟨n, -, i, hi, -⟩ := h
    67	  haveI := hi
    68	  exact finiteInAffine_of_isAffineHom i (finiteInAffine_projectiveSpace n S)

    31	/-- Every finite subset of a scheme is contained in a single affine open. -/
    32	def FiniteInAffine (X : Scheme.{u}) : Prop :=
    33	  ∀ s : Set X, s.Finite → ∃ U : X.affineOpens, s ⊆ U.1

    35	/-- An affine scheme satisfies `FiniteInAffine`. -/
    36	theorem finiteInAffine_of_isAffine (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine X] :
    37	    FiniteInAffine X :=
    38	  fun _ _ ↦ ⟨⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top X⟩, fun _ _ ↦ trivial⟩
    39	
    40	/-- `FiniteInAffine` is invariant under isomorphism. -/
    41	theorem finiteInAffine_of_iso {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (e : X ≅ Y)
    42	    (h : FiniteInAffine X) : FiniteInAffine Y := by
    43	  intro s hs
    44	  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := h (e.hom.base ⁻¹' s)
    45	    (hs.preimage (TopCat.homeoOfIso ((Scheme.forgetToTop).mapIso e)).injective.injOn)
    46	  refine ⟨⟨e.hom ''ᵁ U.1, U.2.image_of_isOpenImmersion e.hom⟩, ?_⟩
    47	  intro y hy
    48	  exact ⟨e.inv.base y, hU (by simpa using hy), by simp⟩
    49

    51	theorem finiteInAffine_of_isAffineHom {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    52	    [IsAffineHom f] (h : FiniteInAffine Y) : FiniteInAffine X := by
    53	  intro s hs
    54	  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := h (f.base '' s) (hs.image _)
    55	  exact ⟨⟨f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1, U.2.preimage f⟩, fun x hx ↦ hU ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩⟩

    60	    FiniteInAffine X.left :=

    64	/-- `FiniteInAffine` supplies the orbit condition for every finite-Galois
    65	semilinear action on the scheme. -/
    66	theorem orbitsInAffineOpen_of_finiteInAffine
    67	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    68	    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    69	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
    70	    (rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f) (h : FiniteInAffine X) :
    71	    rho.OrbitsInAffineOpen where
    72	  exists_affineOpen x := by
    73	    obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ :=
    74	      h (Set.range fun gamma : L ≃ₐ[K] L ↦ (rho.act gamma).hom.base x)
